text: Industrial Designer will produce a working design while also progressing the conceptual design and placing ideas in the project folder for discussion at the next meeting.
The User Interface Designer will specify the technical functions.
Kick-off meeting preparation was insufficient, and several participants feel slow and worry about the pace of the discussion and tasks.

Pricing is set at 25 Euros, with a sales target of 50 million Euros, production cost at half of the selling price, and design requirements to be extendible and user-friendly, to be executed in three phases.
